summary: Renaming the module in tasks is only needed if you changed its name; keep original names if users will use modules outside the role, since FQCNs add context and users can use the collections keyword.
questions: Should I shorten module names when they move into a collection?

answer_card.title: Module naming after migration
answer_card.answer_md: Only update task names if you renamed the module. FQCNs add context so shorter names can work, but if users will use the modules independently of the role, keep the original names. Users can also add the `collections` keyword.
